description: Western Provincial Council -  Notify the Information Technology Resources Development Authority Statute, No. 01 of 2017 and repeal the Statute No. 06 of 2000
reasoning: This gazette content establishes a new provincial statute (Information Technology Resources Development Authority Statute, No. 01 of 2017) that creates a legal framework for information technology resource management in the Western Province. It includes provisions for establishing a corporate authority, defining its composition, management structure, member qualifications, tenure, and operational procedures. The content focuses on creating a regulatory framework and legal provisions rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
